jobs.title: Finance Manager - FP&A & Special Projects
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 39817

Cheers to creating an incredible tomorrow!
At Molson Coors, we tackle big challenges and defy the status quo.  With a proud legacy of excellence, an incredible portfolio of beer, seltzers, spirits, and non-alcohol brands, and a bold vision for our future... we’re on the path to transforming the beverage industry.  That requires remarkable individuals who are curious, tenacious, and never afraid to fail forward.

We seek, value and respect everyone’s unique perspectives and experiences knowing that we are stronger together.  We collaborate as a team and celebrate each other’s successes.

Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

Crafted Highlights:
In the role of  Finance Manager – FP&A & Special Projects  working in Etobicoke, ON, you will be part of the Canada Commercial Finance team. The person will provide finance support to various functions for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis for the Canadian business and spearhead strategic projects at the direction of the CFO. This position reports to the Senior Manager – FP&A and works closely with the CFO, Canadian commercial team, various Finance and Leadership partners, as well as the Molson Coors Technical Accounting, Corporate Financial Planning and Global Business Services groups. This person shall oversee the deliverables of 2 Global Business Services (GBS) employees.

What You’ll Be Brewing:

- Perform month-end close activities, including but not limited to journal entries, accruals, consolidation, financial reporting, forecasting, and ad-hoc reporting.

- Prepare and review the monthly reports with the Molson Coors Canada Leadership Team.

- Coordinate with the Corporate Finance team the results and analytics for the Canada Commercial Finance organization.

- Support enterprise system transformation efforts with agility, ensuring alignment between business needs, processes, and technology solutions

- Prepare and review our Brands and Regionals P&Ls with the Canadian Finance and Commercial Leadership teams.

- Spearhead the creation of regional & channel P&Ls and ensure adoption by regional GMs and their direct reports.

- Prepare reporting and analysis for 3-year strategic plan.

- Demonstrates the initiative to drive change and influence others in support of the organization’s goals and objectives.

- Use accounting principles and knowledge of internal controls to provide objective, timely, and accurate financial information.

- Review, evaluate, and prioritize tasks/project assignments and communicate key issues to management.

- Quarterback / Spearhead several strategic finance projects in close alignment and direction of CFO, CEO, the Canada Strategy Lead, and other members of the Finance Leadership Team; projects span commercial spend analysis, Investment ROI, cost savings & productivity analyses

- Spearhead creation of new Power BI tools and ensure adoption by regional GMs and their direct reports

- Lead and articulate the finance perspective on business performance, strategic priorities, and future direction in senior leadership forums/meetings.

Key Ingredients:

- You have a CPA (or equivalent) designation or are in the process of attaining a CPA (or equivalent) designation; CFA or Masters/MBA with right experience also considered.

- You have at least 4+ years of Senior financial analyst or manager-level experience.

- You have strong Excel skills and experience with financial software (SAP), Power BI, O9; more importantly, you have the ability to grasp new systems and tools quickly, including effective usage of AI for daily task productivity

- You demonstrate a positive and energic attitude and contribute strongly towards a collaborative work culture

Beverage Bonuses:

- We’re one of Canada's Most Attractive Employers

- As the world’s family brewer we have the scale to make big things happen and still get to know colleagues on a first name basis across the globe

- We play our part to make a difference – from charitable donations to hitting the streets together to build parks – giving back to the community is part of our culture and who we are

- You can become a Certified Beer Enthusiast through in-house training that includes everything from brewing techniques to beer tasting and food pairings

- Access to a beer allotment, top events, cool brand clothing and swag, an Employee Assistance Program and discount plans

- Work within a fast-paced and innovative company, meeting passionate colleagues and partners with diverse backgrounds and experiences

- Work schedule Monday through Thursday in office, Friday work from home

Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer.  We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment processes, please e-mail jobs@molsoncoors.com .

Pay and Benefits:

At Molson Coors, we’re committed to paying people fairly and equitably for the work they do.

Job Posting Total Rewards  Offerings: $89,900.00 - $118,000.00 (posting salary range) + 11% target short term incentive + $11,000 on average spent on benefits per employee, including but not limited to health, dental, vision, retirement with above market employer match, wellness incentives and EAP + paid time off (including holidays, vacation days and sick days).

The posting range provided above for salary is what we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We ultimately pay based on a number of non-discriminatory factors that inform pay decisions including but not limited to the required work location, previous work experience, skill set and internal equity.

jobs.title: FP&A Lead/Sr. Manager, Commercial Planning and Consolidation
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 40034

Cheers to creating an incredible tomorrow!
At Molson Coors, we tackle big challenges and defy the status quo.  With a proud legacy of excellence, an incredible portfolio of beer, seltzers, spirits, and non-alcohol brands, and a bold vision for our future... we’re on the path to transforming the beverage industry.  That requires remarkable individuals who are curious, tenacious, and never afraid to fail forward.

We seek, value and respect everyone’s unique perspectives and experiences knowing that we are stronger together.  We collaborate as a team and celebrate each other’s successes.

Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

Crafted Highlights:

In the role of FP&A Lead/Sr. Manager, Commercial Planning and Consolidation working in Toronto, Canada you will be a key part of the Finance team as well as part of Finance Leadership Team (FLT).  You will partner with multiple levels of the organization to build budgets and forecasts, assess current processes and activities to identify enterprise improvement opportunities, drive savings and improve return on investment.

This position reports to the VP Finance/CFO.

What You’ll Be Brewing:

- Most importantly, you will lead a team of talented colleagues (currently 1), and support their growth and development through career discussions and consistent one on one conversations

- Consolidate Canada Commercial P&L for budget, actuals, and forecast, including period close

- Provide accurate and timely P&L’s and financial information with multiple views: National, Region (West/East), Brand, Customer

- Analyze drivers for actual performance vs. plan or forecast and liaise with finance business partner to proactively put plans in place to achieve financial and strategic goals.  Analysis includes NSR, Gross Margin (at Standard), selling, marketing execution and G&A

- Coordinate with FP&A team to implement NA standard reporting and processes

- Key liaison to NA FP&A team to clearly report and explain performance drivers vs. AOP, vs. PY, vs. PLE for all lines in the P&L in accordance with the NA FP&A timelines.

- Ensure adherence to the company's documented financial policies, procedures and internal controls

- Serve as right-hand for VP Finance/CFO and President, for connecting numbers/reports to strategy, guiding cross functional teams to high ROI outcomes.

Key Ingredients:

- You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field required

- You have a CPA designation ideal; masters, in lieu

- You have a minimum 8 years of experience with min 2 years as manager

- You have ideally, substantial exposure to and knowledge of the beer industry and the MolsonCoors Commercial business

- You have demonstrated capabilities with SAP, Excel, and financial modeling

Beverage Bonuses:

- Flexible work programs that support work life balance including a hybrid work model of 4 days in the office

- Participation in our Total Rewards program with a competitive base salary, incentive plans, parental leave, health, dental, vision, retirement plan options with incredible employer match, generous paid time off plans, an engaging Wellness Program, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with amazing resources

- On site Pub, access to cool brand clothing and swag, top events and, of course... free beer and beverages!

- We care about our People and Planet and have challenged ourselves with stretch goals around our key priorities

- We care about our communities, and play our part to make a difference – from charitable donations to hitting the streets together to build parks, giving back to the community is part of our culture and who we are

- Engagement with a variety of Business Resource Groups, which can provide volunteer opportunities, leadership experience, and networking through the organization

- Ability to grow and develop your career centered around our First-Choice Learning opportunities

- Work within a fast-paced and innovative company, meeting passionate colleagues and partners with diverse backgrounds and experiences

#LI-Hybrid

Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer.  We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment processes, please e-mail jobs@molsoncoors.com .

Pay and Benefits:

At Molson Coors, we’re committed to paying people fairly and equitably for the work they do.

Job Posting Total Rewards  Offerings : $123,100.00  -   $161,600.00  (posting salary range) +  16 %  target short term incentive +  $10,000 USD + 400 Non-Qualified Stock Options  target long term incentive +  $11,000  on average spent on benefits per employee, including but not limited to health, dental, vision, retirement with above market employer match, wellness incentives and EAP + paid time off (including holidays, vacation days and sick days).

The posting range provided above for salary is what we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We ultimately pay based on a number of non-discriminatory factors that inform pay decisions including but not limited to the required work location, previous work experience, skill set and internal equity.

Crafted Highlights :

In the role of Marketing Finance Manager working in Toronto, Ontario you will be part of the Finance team. You will serve as an advisor to the Marketing Leadership Team, providing financial guidance and support. This role leads a team of finance professionals and plays a critical role in influencing a broader network of commercial stakeholders. Through execution of the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, the Marketing Finance Manager ensures the delivery of accurate, timely, and insightful financial performance updates for the Canadian Marketing organization and broader Commercial organization, driving business decisions, investment strategies and resource allocation, and enabling financial accountability.

This position reports to Finance Director Marketing and 6 Pints

What You’ll Be Brewing:

- Most importantly, you will lead a team of 3 talented colleagues, and support their growth and development through career discussions and consistent one on one conversations

- Responsible for accounting and reporting including variance analysis of Marketing Expenses in Canada. Delivers actionable financial information to the Marketing team across all levels to assist in functional and decision-making needs.

- Responsible for period end closing responsibilities and key operational control performance.

- Leads the execution of the Marketing budgeting and forecasting process, ensuring strong forecast accuracy along with risk and opportunity identification for inclusion in the Canada Commercial business forecast.

- Influences stakeholders on investment decisions and identifies opportunities to mitigate risk and improve return on marketing investment.

- Responsible for the preparation of partnership reporting and analysis including drivers of actual vs planned performance.

- Supports Finance Director and Marketing leadership in discussion with external partners.

- Prepares or reviews financial inputs and assumptions in business case development for significant investments including sponsorships and innovation, ensuring assumptions and outputs are well vetted.

- Lead and grow a team of financial professionals to provide a high level of service and improve profitability and return on marketing investment.

Key Ingredients:

- You are an authentic leader.  You value and  respect differences and believe everyone’s unique differences is the key to collaboration and a winning team culture

- You have a Bachelor’s degree  in Finance or Accounting OR equivalent experience in the field.

- You have 7+ years of experience of relevant experience

- You have a proven history of strong customer influence

- You can manage multiple competing priorities

- You love a challenge. You complete complex projects quickly and adeptly with your understanding of the business priorities

- You build relationships and collaborate to get to the desired outcome

- You take accountability for results – acting with  integrity and honoring commitments

- You have a thirst for learning – you are always looking for ways to learn and help one another grow

- You exhibit our core values
